user.title: Connect Foto-Upload
user.description: Enter the server address and the Home Assistant status token from Foto-Upload Administration → Security, Funnel & updates. Do not use an administrator password, album password, GitHub token or Home Assistant access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Update authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Copy the Home Assistant status token from Foto-Upload Administration → Security, Funnel & updates. Do not enter an administrator or album password.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) server address without credentials, path, query, or fragment
error.invalid_auth: The read-only status token was rejected
